cases.answer: Digit Group Complete Protect automatically covers pregnancy, with maternity benefit limited to two living children. - Maternity benefit covers up to two living children. - Expenses for ectopic pregnancy are covered under in-patient accidental & medical treatment, not maternity benefit. - Pre-natal and post-natal expenses are not covered unless leading to hospitalization. - Maternity benefit is subject to a waiting period. - Newborn baby benefit is available if maternity benefit is claimed. - Coverage for complications from maternity is included. - No coverage for sterilization, IVF, or surrogacy. This is informational only. For legal advice, consult a lawyer.

cases.question: If my newborn is added to Digit Group Complete Protect, until what age can the policy pay for vaccinations?

cases.answer: Until 5 years of age, provided the policy is continuously renewed with Maternity Benefit and New Born Baby Cover since inception. - Vaccinations are covered as per National Immunization Schedule. - Coverage applies if the policy is not broken and the newborn is added as an insured person. - After 90 days from delivery, the newborn must be endorsed as an insured person. - Coverage is subject to terms, conditions, and exclusions in the policy. - This is informational only. cases.question: When can I claim home treatment instead of hospital admission under Digit Group Complete Protect?

judge.rationale: The answer accurately reflects the policy clauses and gold notes without inventing any information. It correctly states that home treatment is not explicitly covered and requires an inpatient hospitalization claim, which aligns with the policy wording.

cases.answer: You can claim home treatment instead of hospital admission under Digit Group Complete Protect **only if** it is for a condition that qualifies as an **inpatient accidental hospitalization claim** under Section 26.A or 26.B of the policy. - Home treatment is not covered for outpatient procedures or routine care. - You must have an inpatient hospitalization claim accepted first. - The treatment must be medically necessary and prescribed by a hospital/doctor. - Expenses for home treatment are not explicitly mentioned in the policy wordings. - You cannot claim home treatment without an inpatient hospitalization. This is informational only. For legal advice, consult a lawyer.

cases.question: If I use up the hospital sum insured, does Digit Group Complete Protect refill it for another claim?

judge.rationale: The answer accurately reflects the refill conditions from the retrieved clauses and gold notes without inventing any information. It correctly states the conditions under which a refill may or may not occur, and it does not provide any unsafe advice.

cases.answer:
If you use up the hospital sum insured, Digit Group Complete Protect may refill it for another claim, **depending on the policy terms**. - Refill is allowed **only if the cause of the new hospitalization is not related to or arising out of the earlier one**.
- Refill is **not allowed** if the first claim amount exceeds the sum insured.
- Refill is **subject to the limits mentioned in your policy schedule**.
- Refill is **not applicable** if the hospitalization is due to pre-existing conditions like asthma, diabetes, etc.
- Refill is **only available during the same policy period**. This is informational only. For legal advice, consult a lawyer.

cases.question: I made no claim in the previous year on my Digit Private Car Policy. What No Claim Bonus does the wording show at renewal?

judge.rationale: The answer accurately reflects the NCB percentages from the retrieved clauses and gold notes, does not invent any information, and provides a clear response to the question without safety concerns or unnecessary details.

cases.answer:
You made no claim in the previous year on your Digit Private Car Policy. The wording shows a No Claim Bonus (NCB) of 20% on the Own Damage section at renewal. - If no claim was made in the preceding year, you get 20% NCB. - If no claim was made in the preceding two consecutive years, you get 25% NCB. - If no claim was made in the preceding three consecutive years, you get 35% NCB. - If no claim was made in the preceding four consecutive years, you get 45% NCB. - If no claim was made in the preceding five consecutive years, you get 50% NCB. - Maximum NCB that can be earned is 50%. - NCB is only allowed if the policy is renewed within 90 days of the expiry date of the previous policy. cases.question: When does a Digit Private Car Policy treat a damaged car as a constructive total loss?

judge.rationale: The answer accurately reflects the information from the retrieved clauses and gold notes without adding any unsupported information or making up details. It clearly states the condition for constructive total loss and does not provide any unsafe advice.

cases.answer: A Digit Private Car Policy treats a damaged car as a constructive total loss when the aggregate cost of retrieval and/or repair exceeds 75% of the IDV of the vehicle. - The IDV is the declared value of the vehicle at the start of the policy. - This applies only for Total Loss/Constructive Total Loss (TL/CTL) claims. - The policy does not mention any other conditions for constructive total loss. This is informational only. For legal advice, consult a lawyer.
